summary: Connect cloud costs to unit economics, ownership and ROI. Explore hands-on FinOps governance training for technology, finance and product leaders.
lede: Cloud FinOps and cost governance training helps technology, finance and product leaders connect cloud consumption with business value and clarify cost ownership. It develops practical ways to interpret FOCUS cost records, model product unit economics, and design cost allocation and showback while weighing optimization against service risk. Learners also practice reviewing forecasts and presenting costs alongside outcomes through cross-functional governance routines, using case data and spreadsheet analysis.
audienceIntro: This course suits leaders and practitioners who make, explain or influence cloud investment decisions. It is designed for professionals who need to link consumption data to business priorities and establish workable cost ownership across technical and financial teams.
modules: FinOps Operating Model and Decision Rights
ROI Reporting and Governance Action Plan
prerequisites: Prior experience overseeing, forecasting, approving or consuming cloud budgets is recommended. No coding or cloud-platform administration is required. Access to a laptop and spreadsheet software such as Excel supports the cost analysis exercises.
